usedFor: Harvestr holds feedback discoveries and users, and Google Drive makes a file shareable through “Share File With Anyone”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Discovery Created” in Harvestr, then “Share File With Anyone” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: A new discovery can publish a file link, set to Viewer, Commenter or Editor access.

watchOut: “New Discovery Created” in Harvestr is polling, so the file link goes out after a scheduled check.
